scenarios.healthy: nothing fails, 20 calls/s: the happy path
scenarios.transient: 15% of attempts fail (refused, 503, slow +3 s, no answer), 20 calls/s
scenarios.outage: the dependency refuses everything for 30 s of 90 s, 30 calls/s, 40 different reads
scenarios.blackhole: the dependency stops answering for 30 s of 90 s (no refusal, just silence), 30 calls/s
scenarios.retry storm: overload: 85 calls/s into a server good for 100/s that runs 3x slower for 15 s of 120 s (queue of 400)
scenarios.thundering herd: 400 calls at the same moment, server good for 100/s with a queue of 60
scenarios.noisy neighbour: one app, 24 slots, two dependencies: `slow` (10 calls/s) is silent for 40 s of 80 s, `fine` (25 calls/s) is healthy
scenarios.rate limit: the server admits 25 calls per second and answers the rest with 429 + Retry-After: 1; 15 calls/s plus bursts of 60
scenarios.lost answers: writes: 12% of attempts are done but the answer is lost, 5% refused, 10 writes/s; clients retry
scenarios.layered calls: `front` calls `back`, both with retries; `back` is silent for 20 s of 60 s, 20 calls/s
